evals.prompt: Humaniza este capitulo de tesis para que pase Turnitin sin perder rigor academico
evals.expected_output: Texto revisado con las 9 tecnicas y verificacion con detect_ai.py
expectations: Runs as the final pass, after content and citations are final
Varies sentence structure and burstiness without changing claims or evidence
Runs detect_ai.py and reports the before/after score

evals.prompt: Este ensayo lo marca GPTZero al 95% IA, reescribelo manteniendo las citas
evals.expected_output: Ensayo reescrito con burstiness y score de deteccion reducido
expectations: Preserves every citation and reference exactly
Rewrites for burstiness instead of only swapping synonyms
Reports a reduced detection score from a local check

evals.prompt: Revision final de mi articulo: citas y referencias ya estan, solo hazlo sonar humano
evals.expected_output: Pase final sin cambios de contenido, solo estilo y ritmo
expectations: Changes only style and rhythm, not content or structure
Does not add or remove citations
